posts.title: New in PMP: Mesh Analysis
posts.description: Many mesh processing algorithms expect reasonably well-formed manifold surface meshes. The same is true for PMP , where manifold meshes are assumed throughout and algorithms may fail in the presence of defects. posts.title: Connected Components of a Polygon Mesh
posts.description: In mesh processing, we often assume ideal 2-manifold meshes consisting of a single connected component. posts.title: Public Drafts With Jekyll
posts.description: I’m using Jekyll , a static site generator, to build this website 1 .
